strings.game.title: Aoi, After School
strings.char.aoi.name: Aoi
strings.char.rin.name: Rin
strings.char.mei.name: Mei
strings.char.yuu.name: Yuu
strings.ending.good.title: Two of Us
strings.ending.normal.title: The Long Way Home
strings.s01.intro: The classroom held nothing but slanted light and the smell of chalk. Everyone had gone home an hour ago. Everyone, it seemed, except—
strings.s01.yuu.001: Yeah. I lost track of time, I guess.
strings.s01.aoi.003: Then we match. I do that all the time.
strings.s01.rin.004: Aoi! There you are— oh. Am I interrupting something?
strings.s01.aoi.005: R-Rin! It's nothing, we were just talking!
strings.s01.mei.006: Aoi. The student council needs the room key back before you leave.
strings.s01.aoi.007: Right— the key. I almost forgot I still had it.
strings.s01.key.caption: The brass key to Class 2-B. Warm from being held all afternoon.
strings.s01.rin.008: So! Lunch tomorrow, the four of us? You're coming too, right?
strings.s01b.title: A Moment to Spare
strings.s01b.intro: Rin's question hangs in the air. The brass key is still warm in your hand — what do you do with the moment before you answer?
strings.s01b.opt.linger: Linger, and meet Aoi's eyes a little longer.
strings.s01b.opt.tidy: Help gather the scattered worksheets together.
strings.s01b.opt.slip: Quietly drift toward the door instead.
strings.s02.intro: The rooftop had caught the last of the sun. Below us the town was turning gold, then amber, then something softer.
strings.s02.cg_note: She turned, and for a moment the whole sky was behind her.
strings.s02.aoi.good: Hey— thanks for staying. I'm glad it was you in that classroom.
strings.s02.aoi.normal: Guess I'll head down first. …See you tomorrow, maybe.
